fieldNotes.truckGate: Perimeter fence with a cantilever/swing vehicle gate across the single entrance drive, confirmed in Street View (pano kxxnsKTYgGxLwYeEvcPzhQ, 2022-12) looking W/SW at ~260-270 deg.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white booth structure beside the gate visible in Street View; staffed-booth call is medium confidence given camera distance, but structure footprint and placement beside the gate are consistent with a guard shack at a major Target food DC.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and deep approach drive with unused paved width to add a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long bank of dock doors along the east building face with ~50-70 reefer trailers backed in; counted from zoom-20/21 imagery, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated striped trailer drop yard east of the building holding two long rows of reefers (40+ stalls).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible in the entrance path; listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park near Denton Enterprise Airport with open fields adjacent; judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron between the gate and the dock doors provides interior queuing room.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Traced inside the fence line / property edge; ~30 acres. North bound is the Airport Rd setback, east bound the curving access drive, west bound the shared property line with the neighbor lot.

citations.claim: Target opened a 360,000 sq ft grocery/food distribution center near Denton Airport (3255 Airport Rd), serving 235 stores across eight states with ribbon-cutting attended by Denton city leaders.
Farmer's Fridge lists the Denton Target Distribution Center (3255 Airport Rd) as an active on-site fridge location, corroborating current staffed operation.

verification.rationale: Target food DC at 3255 Airport Rd, Denton TX opened 2013 (Tier-1 press) and shows continued current operation (active on-site amenity); partial 'Airport Rd' address resolves to the operating facility. NOT under construction/announced. No closure signal.
